description.text: Objectives The program in Design Science provides students with solid theory and knowledge of art, design, and digital media. Students will learn and understand new methods and new trends of visual art and design in China and abroad. Graduates from the program should be able to create visual design with modern art concepts, forms, and means. We encourage our students to be innovative and creative in working with professionals from different disciplines. Duration Duration of program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Industrial Product Design and Digitalization 2. Human-computer Interaction Design and Digitalization 3. Digital Design for Cultural-creative Products Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 41credits. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Design Science at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
